newsitem.title: JAPAN: Matsushita to boost TV output to 14 mln by 2000/01.
newsitem.headline: Matsushita to boost TV output to 14 mln by 2000/01.

text.p: Matsushita Electric Industrial Co Ltd said on Monday that it plans to boost its worldwide production of television sets to 14 million by the 2000/2001 business year.
Matsushita is targeting 10 percent of the world's television market by then, up from the current 8.5 percent, a company spokesman said.
According to the plan, the company's European, U.S. and Asian operations will each produce four million TVs per year, while its China and Japan units will produce a total of two million TVs.
Matsushita has been considering countries with prospects of strong economic growth, such as India, China, Vietnam and Czechoslovakia, in making its decision to set up new production bases.
The company will now focus on increasing production in the new areas, the spokesman said.
